definitions.gloss: board of directors; board of trustees; board meeting
definitions.explanation: The governing body of an organization, or a meeting of that body. Used for corporations, associations, condominiums, universities, and other organizations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧{理事会|りじかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A board meeting will be held next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理事会|りじかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: I attended the condominium board meeting.

examples.japanese: {理事会|りじかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{予算|よさん}{案|あん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new budget proposal was approved at the board meeting.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for governing bodies of various organizations. In Japanese condominiums (⟦{分譲|ぶんじょう}→分譲：06577_bunjou⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧), the {理事会|りじかい} is the management board elected by unit owners. Also used for corporate boards, university governing bodies, and associations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理事会|りじかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to hold a board meeting)
- {理事会|りじかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧ (to attend a board meeting)
- {理事会|りじかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧ (board decision)
- {理事会|りじかい}⟦{役員|やくいん}→役員：11329_yakuin⟧ (board member)
